dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lisa. I'm fine now.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Do you come to visit Collei often, cutie?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #{M#He}{F#She}'s amazing. All of us in Gandharva Ville already have a lot to thank {M#him}{F#her} for.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Collei and I are very good friends.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well then, it seems my little Collei has been making some new friends in Sumeru.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And I've been doing my best to learn how to read. Now I can even read some simple sentences!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Master and everyone in Sumeru has taken good care of me, but I've never forgotten my friends in Mondstadt. I've actually been thinking about taking some time to go back for a visit.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Miss Lisa, how's everyone doing? Well, I hope? What about Amber? And Kaeya? Oh, and Jean?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha, slow down, Collei. I'll tell you all about them...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Sorry, darling, seems I'll need some time here. I want to tell Collei about what's happening in Mondstadt.
